stem: Which statement correctly describes a performance requirement of nitrous oxide delivery equipment?

options.text: It must be able to give 100% oxygen, never less than 25% oxygen, and use a flow rate suited to patient size
It may use one fixed flow rate for every patient regardless of size
It may drop below 25% oxygen when a higher nitrous oxide concentration is wanted
It needs only to deliver preset mixtures and need not be able to give 100% oxygen
